en: A multiview seaside postcard showing scenes from Constanța, Romania: a modernist building and landscaped boulevard, fishermen on a lagoon with high-rise hotels in the distance, a landscaped park with cars, a crowded sandy beach with resort hotels, and a large neoclassical theater facade labeled "TEATRUL DE STAT." The design includes a nautical anchor emblem. Reverse has a Romanian handwritten message, a Romanian 40 bani stamp with the socialist coat of arms, and a postmark reading Constanța-Litoral.
